# HIMANN - Professional Faucet Manufacturer (haimanfaucet.com)

## Core Information
- Website Goal: B2B OEM/ODM manufacturing and export of faucets and sanitary ware.
- Company: Quanzhou Haiman Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. (brand: HIMANN), established 2005.
- Facility: 26,000 m² integrated plant in Quanzhou, Fujian, China.
- Key Capabilities: brass gravity casting, CNC machining, 100% automated pressure testing on every unit.
- Response Time: technical drawings and volume quotations within 12 hours.
- Contact: sales@haimanfaucet.com | WhatsApp +86 18960227084 | WeChat HaimanFaucet.

## Product Categories
- Kitchen Faucets: pull-out and pull-down mixers, commercial sprayers (e.g. Model 826006, 826019, 826033).
- Shower Systems: thermostatic rain systems, handheld sets (e.g. Model 208001A, 861301).
- Basin Mixers: classic, sensor and designer taps (e.g. Model 811011, 24060, 811048).
- Angle Valves: SUS304 and high-pressure valves (e.g. Model 218003, 881301, 28103).
